1.title: 1. Introduction to the Privacy Policy
1.aboutMarkeeText: We are a provider of AI-powered marketing assistant solutions, helping users optimize content creation and management processes.
1.applicableSubjectsText: This policy applies to all individuals and organizations that register an account, access, or use any features on the Markee AI system.
1.scopeText: Applies to all data collection activities through the website markeeai.com, custom tools (widgets), and directly integrated services we provide.

2.title: 2. Information We Collect
2.accountInfoText: Includes username, email address, phone number, password (encrypted), and business-related information such as company name and industry to help the AI understand context.
2.contentText: Prompts, text, images, or documents you provide for AI processing.
2.schedulingText: Data related to post planning and scheduled publishing times.
2.interactionsText: How you respond to AI-generated results (edits, copies, saves).
2.thirdPartyConnectionsText: When connecting APIs (Facebook, Instagram, etc.), we collect reach metrics, engagement, managed pages list, and necessary identifiers for auto-posting or analytics.
2.technicalDataText: IP address, device type, operating system, browser, cookies to remember login sessions and interface preferences.

3.title: 3. Purposes of Information Use
3.provideOperateText: Ensure features such as content generation, Fanpage analysis, and scheduling function correctly and stably.
3.trainImproveAIText: Use aggregated data to fine-tune AI models for more natural and accurate responses. We commit not to publicly disclose or sell raw individual data for this purpose.
3.personalizeText: Analyze usage patterns to recommend the most suitable templates or marketing strategies for your style.
3.supportSecurityText: Authenticate identity on login, protect accounts from unauthorized access, and quickly respond to technical support requests.

4.title: 4. Sharing Your Information
4.infrastructurePartnersText: To process natural language, some data (e.g., prompts) may be sent via API to large AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI). Data is transferred encrypted and complies with partner privacy terms.
4.legalComplianceText: We will disclose personal information if requested by a court or competent state authority in cases related to legal violations.
4.commercialCommitmentText: Markee AI affirms that it does not sell, trade, or rent email lists, personal identifiers, or business data to third-party advertisers.

5.title: 5. Data Storage and Processing
5.storageLocationText: Your data is stored on international-standard cloud servers, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery.
5.accountRetention: Account information is retained until the user requests deletion or completely ceases using the service.
5.logsRetention: Logs and session data may be kept for a shorter period (typically 6–24 months) for technical analysis.
5.deletionProcessingText: When you request account deletion, the system will delete or anonymize all personal information within 30 days, except for payment-related data required by tax regulations.

6.title: 6. Your Rights and Choices
6.accessEditText: You can update personal information or brand settings anytime in the Dashboard.
6.exportDataText: Markee AI provides tools to export created content or analytics reports in common formats (PDF, Excel).
6.deleteDataText: Users have the right to request complete deletion of created content or the entire personal profile.
6.connectionManagementText: You have full control to grant or revoke connections to social platforms directly in the settings interface.

7.title: 7. Security of Your Information
7.technicalMeasuresText: We apply SSL/TLS encryption for all data transmitted between user devices and servers. Sensitive data is protected by multiple firewall layers.
7.internalControlsText: Only staff with specific duties and who have signed confidentiality agreements can access limited data portions for customer support.
7.liabilityLimitText: While we use state-of-the-art measures, we cannot completely eliminate risks from sophisticated cyberattacks. Markee AI will notify users immediately if a data breach is detected.

8.title: 8. AI Data and User Content
8.contentOwnershipText: All text, ideas, and AI-generated outputs based on your prompts are legally owned by you.
8.inputDataHandlingText: We treat your prompts and internal documents as private property. The system will never use this raw data to display publicly to other users.
8.brandVoiceSecurityText: The “Brand Voice” you create is applied exclusively to your account.

9.title: 9. Children's Information
9.ageLimitText: Our service is not intended for individuals under 16 years old. If we become aware that we have collected data from a minor, we will promptly delete it.
9.violationHandlingText: We do not actively collect children's data. If unauthorized child data is discovered, we will immediately delete it.

10.title: 10. Legal Compliance
10.scopeOfDisclosureText: In case of legal requests, Markee AI will only provide the minimum data directly relevant to the request, maximizing user privacy.
10.notificationText: Unless prohibited by law, we will endeavor to notify users when their data is requested by third parties.

11.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
11.policyChangesText: We reserve the right to update this policy to reflect changes in data handling practices or legal requirements.
11.notificationMethodText: Important changes will be notified via your registered email or prominently displayed on the homepage for at least 7 days before taking effect.

12.title: 12. Contact Us
12.contactText: For any questions, complaints, or requests regarding personal data, please contact us at:
12.liveSupportText: Chat widget in the bottom corner of the website.

items.content: Markee AI confirms that it does not trade, sell, or rent email lists, identification information, or corporate data of users to third-party advertisers.

items.title: Limitation of Liability
items.content: Although we apply the most advanced measures, risks from complex cyber-attacks cannot be completely ruled out. Markee AI will notify users immediately if a data leak incident is detected.

items.title: Content Ownership
items.content: All texts, ideas, and results generated by AI based on your prompts belong to your legal ownership.

items.title: Input Data Processing
items.content: We consider your prompts and internal documents as private property. The system will never use this raw data to publicly display to other users.

items.title: Model Security

items.title: Violation Handling
items.content: We do not actively collect children's data. If unauthorized collection of children's information is detected, we will take steps to remove that information immediately.

items.title: Scope of Provision
items.content: In case of legal requirements, Markee AI only provides minimal data directly related to that request, to ensure the greatest possible privacy rights for users.

items.title: Notification
items.content: Unless prohibited by law, we will strive to notify users when there is a request to provide their data to a third party.

items.title: Policy Changes
items.content: We reserve the right to update this policy to reflect changes in data processing or changes in the law.

items.title: Notification Method
items.content: Any significant changes will be notified via your registered email or prominently displayed on the website homepage at least 07 days before taking effect.
